learnings: Include specific, eye-catching figures ($11B, 99%, 48 Hours) in titles to trigger instant curiosity.
Place emotional high-stakes keywords ('Scam', 'Broke', 'Exposed') within the first 3 words of the title.
Hook the audience immediately in the first 2 seconds without introductory fluff or greetings.
Leverage auto-captioning with bold, centered text as most viewers watch Shorts with audio muted.
Maintain a fast pacing structure with visual or audio cuts every 1.5 to 2.5 seconds to boost retention.
End Shorts with a seamless loop or a strong curiosity-driven prompt rather than a generic call to subscribe.
double_down: High-stakes energy and oil industry scandals (e.g., corporate cover-ups, multi-billion dollar frauds).
Financial collapse stories focusing on how a single event nearly destroyed a national economy.
Exposés on massive automotive and industrial corruption scandals (e.g., emissions cheats, defective recalls).
avoid: Making drastic content pivots based on single-digit view counts and extremely small sample sizes.
Dry, academic explanations of economic concepts without a clear antagonist, scam, or dramatic narrative.
Slow-paced video openings that spend more than 3 seconds explaining background history before delivering the payoff.
